name: High-Conviction Backwardation Regime Analysis — ZC & ZS
description: Three-regime carry analysis: high backwardation (carry > 5%), low backwardation (0% < carry ≤ 5%), and contango (carry ≤ 0). Uses normalized carry = (M1-M2)/M1 via spread_depth=1. Two continuations: NoAdjustment for carry/regime classification, BackwardRatio for clean 63-day forward returns. Outputs: (1) Stats table with avg yield, hit rate, and observation count per regime; (2) Year × Month heatmap of monthly avg carry; (3) Bar chart comparing avg next-quarter roll yield across three regimes; (4) Event markers on high-backwardation entry dates showing carry level and next-quarter return.
source:
# =============================================================================
# HIGH-CONVICTION BACKWARDATION REGIME ANALYSIS — ZC & ZS
# =============================================================================
# Three regimes based on normalized carry = (M1 - M2) / M1:
#   1. High Backwardation: carry > 5%
#   2. Low Backwardation:  0% < carry <= 5%
#   3. Contango:           carry <= 0%
#
# Tests whether high-conviction backwardation predicts superior next-quarter
# (63-day) forward returns vs low backwardation and contango.
#
# Two continuations per asset:
#   1. NoAdjustment + spread_depth=1 — for carry signal & regime classification
#   2. BackwardRatio — for clean forward returns (roll yield proxy)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: NoAdjustment for carry/regime ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Data: BackwardRatio for forward returns ---
cont_adj = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Carry signal: (M1 - M2) / M1 ---
carry_signal = cont.spread / cont.c

# --- Three-regime classification ---
is_high_back = carry_signal > 0.05
is_low_back = carry_signal > 0 and carry_signal <= 0.05
is_contango = carry_signal <= 0

# --- Next-quarter (63-day) forward return as roll yield proxy ---
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(cont_adj.c)

# --- Regime-conditional metrics for summary table ---
# Avg carry by regime
carry_in_high = where(is_high_back, carry_signal)
carry_in_low = where(is_low_back, carry_signal)
carry_in_cont = where(is_contango, carry_signal)

# Avg forward return by regime
fwd_in_high = where(is_high_back, fwd_63d)
fwd_in_low = where(is_low_back, fwd_63d)
fwd_in_cont = where(is_contango, fwd_63d)

# Hit rate: % of regime days where next-quarter return > 0
hit_high = where(is_high_back and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_low = where(is_low_back and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_cont = where(is_contango and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Calendar components for heatmap ---
ts = index()
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Monthly carry for heatmap (downsample to 1 value per month) ---
monthly_carry = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.mean)(carry_signal)
monthly_ts = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(year_num)
monthly_month = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Three-Regime Statistics Table
# Columns: Obs Count, Avg Carry, Avg Next-Qtr Yield, Hit Rate
# Uses Count on where-filtered series for observation count
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Three-Regime Roll Yield Statistics',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['High Backwardation (>5%)', 'Low Backwardation (0-5%)', 'Contango (<=0%)'],
        col_headers=['Obs Count', 'Avg Carry', 'Avg Next-Qtr Yield', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Regime Summary',
    order=0
)(carry_in_high, carry_in_high, fwd_in_high, hit_high, carry_in_low, carry_in_low, fwd_in_low, hit_low, carry_in_cont, carry_in_cont, fwd_in_cont, hit_cont)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Monthly Carry Regime Heatmap (Year x Month)
# Positive (green) = backwardation, Negative (red) = contango
# =============================================================================
heatmap(
    title='Monthly Avg Carry Regime (Year x Month)',
    category='2. Regime Seasonality',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    order=1
)(x=monthly_month, y=monthly_ts, value=monthly_carry)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Avg Next-Quarter Roll Yield by Three Regimes
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Next-Quarter Roll Yield by Carry Regime',
    category='3. Predictiveness',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High Back (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low Back (0-5%)', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_in_high, fwd_in_low, fwd_in_cont))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Event Markers for High-Backwardation Entry Dates
# Shows carry level and next-quarter return at each high-conviction date
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='High Backwardation Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Next-Qtr Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Filter', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry_signal, fwd_63d, is_high_back)
